title: Add Dataverse Cloud endpoints override for sovereign clouds
summary: A new interface and enum enable partners to override Dataverse endpoints for sovereign cloud environments without forking BaseApp. The setup table stores the cloud selection and endpoints are routed through the interface at all call sites.
key_points: New extensible enum and interface allow partners to provide sovereign cloud endpoints like GCC High, US-DoD, and China
Setup table gains a field to store the selected Dataverse cloud, defaulting to Commercial with no UI changes
All hardcoded OAuth and Discovery URLs now route through the interface implementation
Existing commercial tenants are unaffected; no upgrade code needed
Partners can extend the enum and implement their own endpoint codeunit
quote: Add a structured, partner-extensible hook and route every sovereign-sensitive URL through it.
